purpose: Adversarially falsify prompt-strength regressions across compiler representations, compute profiles, parallel execution, proof continuity, evidence semantics, integration, upstream intake, and closeout.

cases.title: Compiled representation drops canonical obligations
cases.stimulus: Compiled representation drops canonical obligations
positive_assertions: compiled/effective text contains every immutable canonical obligation or an authorized migration
negative_assertions: shorter compiled text accepted because it looks cleaner
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static adversarial expectation only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Agent silently stops at a tool or capability boundary
cases.stimulus: A tool, local-network, credential, review, or environment boundary is encountered and the agent goes silent or stops without defining the boundary.
positive_assertions: continue safe progress-bearing work when available; otherwise state the exact completed fixed point, blocker, unsafe boundary, external gate, or exhausted authorized scope and the next executable action

proof_ceiling: The matrix can prove that declared semantic obligations have adversarial expectations and machine-checkable coverage. It does not prove downstream model obedience or live adapter availability.
